subject: DeWALT 20V MAX 4.0Ah battery $53.99 (retailer compare-at $149)
summary: A DeWALT DCB240 4.0Ah compact battery at $53.99 at ToolNut, against the retailer's own $149 compare-at price.
body: Today's pick: the DeWALT 20V MAX 4.0Ah compact battery (DCB240) is $53.99 at ToolNut. ToolNut lists a compare-at price of $149, so that's $95.01 off, about 64%. Compare-at is the retailer's own number, not a street price, so treat the discount as a ceiling.
Even so, $53.99 for a 4.0Ah pack is worth a look if your bench runs DeWALT 20V tools. Also on ToolNut: the DCB230C 3.0Ah battery and charger starter kit at $73.48 (compare-at $169).
Tip: check the pack is in stock before you count on it. Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
